rules: Hotel cost per night must not exceed the cap for the city tier unless a signed approval memo covers the excess.
Per diem is paid per trip day (inclusive) at the destination tier rate; claimed per diem above that is not reimbursable.
Every item in a receipt-required category needs a receipt. Flights also need a boarding pass.
Every expense date must fall within the trip dates.
Two items with the same receipt number are duplicates. The same category, date and amount without distinct receipt numbers is a suspected duplicate that needs evidence.

A late check-out fee is reimbursable only when a business meeting in the hotel's city ends after the standard check-out time and the requested check-out is at most 2 hours after the meeting ends, up to 50% of the nightly cap.
Hotel nights must fall within the trip dates.
A boarding pass must match the flight number, date and passenger name.

triage.note: Assumed average time a finance officer spends checking one claim by hand (synthetic estimate).
